title: Udemy and Mila team up to accelerate responsible AI skills for the global workforce
summary: Artificial intelligence is reshaping how we work, think, and create—but for many organizations, the pace of innovation is rapidly outpacing their teams’ readiness. body_text: Udemy and Mila team up to accelerate responsible AI skills for the global workforce December 9, 2025 By Paxton Mittleman Udemy News Artificial intelligence is reshaping how we work, think, and create—but for many organizations, the pace of innovation is rapidly outpacing their teams’ readiness. AI adoption is skyrocketing, yet skills, governance, and ethical frameworks haven’t kept up, creating growing operational, strategic, and compliance gaps. To help close this divide and ensure AI is applied thoughtfully and responsibly, Udemy is proud to announce a new partnership with Mila , a leading global AI research institute helping individuals and organizations build essential skills to adopt AI technologies responsibly, ethically, and effectively. Founded by Turing Award winner and AI pioneer Yoshua Bengio , Mila is globally recognized for its cutting-edge research and leadership in Responsible AI. Together, Mila and Udemy are developing learning experiences that combine technical understanding with real-world ethical frameworks—equipping today’s professionals to navigate and learn AI with the urgency, judgment, and accountability required in this rapidly accelerating era. What to expect from this new programming In January, Udemy and Mila will begin launching new content and learning programs that put responsible AI into action—equipping learners and companies alike with the tools to innovate thoughtfully, inclusively, and sustainably. This will include: Courses on Responsible AI, ethics, governance, and practical decision-making Applied training on integrating responsible practices into professional workflows Designed for business leaders, technical teams, marketers, and more, this programming meets learners where they are—across industries, roles, and regions. Together, we’re shaping a more skilled, ethical, and future-ready workforce—powered by AI, built for humans. Why responsible AI skills matter now According to Udemy research , demand for AI learning has surged dramatically—AI course enrollments for technologies like generative AI, Microsoft Copilot, and GitHub Copilot have grown between 3,400% and 13,500% year over year, underscoring how quickly employees are trying to catch up. Yet readiness still lags: only 41% of employees feel prepared to use AI tools, and 56% believe AI won’t impact their role, revealing a widespread blind spot in workforce awareness (according to a new study Udemy conducted with YouGov). Meanwhile, few organizations have the governance structures they need. Enrollment in AI ethics and governance courses on Udemy grew 98% year over year, signaling heightened concern—but many companies still lack the frameworks to act. Third-party research reinforces these gaps: Microsoft reports that 70% of companies struggle to equip employees with essential AI skills, and a global KPMG study found that over half of employees conceal their AI use and lack the training to evaluate outputs for accuracy or bias. As a result, a widening disconnect between innovation and understanding has emerged—and there’s a growing need for education that blends practical AI skills with responsible implementation. This is the challenge Udemy and Mila are tackling together: helping organizations keep pace with AI while ensuring their teams are trained not just in the tools, but in the thinking, context, and responsibility required to use them safely and effectively. A shared vision for the future of work Mila brings deep expertise in academic AI research and policy, while Udemy brings a global platform used by 82 million learners and over 17,000 organizations around the world. By combining Mila’s insights with Udemy’s flexible learning model, we are building programming that’s grounded in academic rigor, delivered by real-world experts, and designed to scale across industries, roles, and regions. Through this new programming, individuals and organizations can: Understand the foundations of Responsible AI—from how it works to how it impacts business Implement AI ethically and securely Build a responsible AI culture that enables innovation without compromising trust This partnership isn’t just about technical training—it’s about shaping a future-ready workforce that’s equipped to lead with both capability and conscience. How to stay informed We plan to begin rolling out new course content in January. In the meantime, get a jump start by learning more about our comprehensive AI upskilling initiatives here . body_text: For Investors View All News Crane NXT Completes First Phase of Antares Vision Acquisition December 16, 2025 WALTHAM, Mass., Dec. 16, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Crane NXT, Co. (NYSE: CXT) ("Crane NXT" or the "Company"), a premier industrial technology company, today announced the completion of its acquisition of approximately 32% of Antares Vision S.p.A. (“Antares Vision”) on a fully diluted basis from Regolo S.p.A. (“Regolo”) and Sargas S.r.L (“Sargas”). This milestone marks the first phase of Crane NXT’s acquisition of Antares Vision. Under the terms of the definitive agreements, Crane NXT purchased this initial stake in Antares Vision at a price of €5.00 per share for a total consideration of approximately €117 million. The closing follows receipt of all required regulatory approvals. Aaron W. Saak, Crane NXT’s President and Chief Executive Officer, stated: “We are excited to complete our initial investment in Antares Vision, marking a significant step forward in advancing our strategy and expanding our portfolio into the Life Sciences and Food & Beverage sectors. We look forward to continuing our partnership with Antares Vision as we move toward the next phase of this transaction.” As previously announced, the next step under applicable Italian takeover rules will be a mandatory tender offer (“MTO”) for the remaining publicly traded shares of Antares Vision at the same price of €5.00 per share. Following completion of the MTO, Crane NXT will acquire the remaining stake owned by Regolo and undertake to delist Antares Vision, in compliance with Italian takeover rules, which is expected to be completed in 2026. About Crane NXT, Co. Crane NXT is a premier industrial technology company that provides trusted technology solutions to secure, detect, and authenticate what matters most to its customers. Through its industry-leading businesses, Crane NXT provides customers with advanced technologies to secure high-value physical products, sophisticated detection equipment and systems, and proprietary products and services that protect brand identity. Crane NXT’s approximately 5,000 employees help our customers protect their most important assets and ensure secure, seamless transactions around the world every day. For more information visit www.cranenxt.com . About Antares Vision S.p.A. Antares Vision is an Italian multinational company that ensures product safety and supply chain transparency through innovative technologies for quality control, end-to-end traceability and integrated data management. The company operates primarily in the Life Sciences and Food & Beverage sectors, supporting companies in digitalizing processes to improve sustainability, efficiency, productivity and visibility. It is a world leader in drug traceability, supplying the world's leading manufacturers and numerous government authorities. It is present in more than 60 countries, employs approximately 1,200 people and has a network of more than 40 international partners. The company has been listed on the Euronext STAR Milan segment (EXM, AV:IM) since 2021. For more information visit www.antaresvision.com . title: How to Spot Whitespace Opportunities in a Crowded Market
summary: Discover untapped market opportunities with whitespace analysis. Learn data-driven strategies to identify consumer trends and gaps in crowded markets.
body_text: Find Untapped Market Opportunities with Whitespace Analysis Today's consumer packaged goods (CPG) market is becoming increasingly saturated, leading to fierce competition among brands vying for the same customers. Roughly 30,000 products hit the market each year, but an estimated 85 percent fail within just two years. To achieve success, brands must do more than simply innovate. They must also be strategic, identifying where rivals are falling short and what types of products consumers can't currently find. Whitespace opportunities represent unmet consumer needs and underserved segments that the competition is not yet capitalizing on. These opportunities aren't guesses or hunches. They're data-driven discoveries about what shoppers truly want and need. Beauty, wellness, and food brands that are standing out are leveraging trend data and search signals to unveil powerful insights, spotting gaps in the market that need filling. They're using data to uncover opportunities that are hiding in plain sight, all before they become obvious to the market at large. What Are Whitespace Opportunities in Market Research? In market research, whitespace opportunities are gaps between what consumers want and what's currently available. Market whitespaces exist even in the most crowded markets. Consumer preferences are constantly shifting and evolving. New routines, new values, and new curiosities drive fresh demand every day, and those untapped market opportunities have great potential for brands. Whitespace opportunities can take many forms. • Unmet Consumer Needs: These market gaps exist when shoppers are searching for solutions that don't exist. Take, for example, the interest in products to repair and protect the skin barrier. Interest surged on social media platforms like TikTok , leading to a rise in gentler, microbiome-safe products. • Emerging Cultural or Lifestyle Shifts: Changing lifestyle habits can pave the way to great innovation. For instance, as the world began to recognize the importance of gut health, new prebiotic drinks and supplements became big business. • New Ingredients and Product Categories: Whitespace opportunities can also come in the form of new ingredients. One example is the widespread adoption of retinols in beauty and skincare. While they've been available for decades, the consumer trend analysis unveiled massive interest in over-the-counter retinol products in the early 2010s. Thus, a billion-dollar market was born. Using Consumer Search Data to Identify Market Gaps To identify whitespace opportunities, brands must move past gut feelings and basic assumptions. For many decades, companies in the beauty and wellness space have set trends. However, thanks to the Internet, consumers now have all the power. With a world of information at their fingertips, the vast majority of shoppers research products and brands before making a purchase. Brands can utilize those search signals to discover those elusive, untapped market opportunities. Analyzing billions of search signals helps brands understand what consumers are actively looking for but can't find. Search behaviors can highlight unmet consumer needs. For instance, search behavior may indicate that people are repeatedly looking for something that only a few brands, if any, address. That's a whitespace opportunity. It goes even deeper than that. Because fads come and go quickly, you can rely on search signals to differentiate those fast-fading trends from shifts with true staying power. Growth in search volume over time indicates that a trend is gaining momentum. Meanwhile, a sudden spike in interest may only reflect short-term interests. This data-driven approach eliminates the guesswork from product development, enabling brands to base major decisions on the direction the market is truly heading. Rather than making those decisions on a hunch, brands can follow the market and identify whitespace opportunities worth capitalizing on. Tracking Search Volume Trends for Emerging Opportunities In a saturated and competitive market, trend forecasting to capitalize on those whitespace opportunities before other brands do can mean the difference between standout success and falling by the wayside. Monitoring search volume changes can help you spot potentially game-changing opportunities early on. For example, consider a sudden surge in a particular ingredient, concern or product type. That signals rising consumer interest and is something worth keeping an eye on. As mentioned earlier, not all spikes in search volume reflect a genuine whitespace opportunity. Some are simple fads that can fade quickly. To differentiate those fads from real trends, year-over-year growth rates can be a helpful signal. You want slow, steady growth rather than a massive spike and sudden fade. A trend can show strong YoY growth due to a single spike and still fade quickly if interest is not sustained beyond that period. Examine historical search volume data alongside signals like sustained growth, awareness level, and predicted future performance to see how interest has changed over time. A steady increase in search volume, paired with medium to very high awareness and positive predicted YoY growth, points to long-term consumer shifts rather than fleeting curiosity. Knowing how to separate the two is crucial. This type of early signal analysis allows brands to strike while the iron is still heating up. Brands can get ahead of the competition by introducing products as the trend is developing, rather than waiting until the market is already saturated. Analyzing TikTok and Social Signals for Whitespace Search data can unveil what people are curious about. However, social media can reveal what people are actively discussing. Social media content, especially on platforms like TikTok, is a valuable resource for consumer trend analysis, helping brands discover what's capturing attention and building momentum. Social media plays a major role in how beauty and wellness trends take shape, with the largest platforms often acting as early indicators. They can also accelerate trends and reveal whitespace opportunities in specific product categories or demographics. For example, the "glass skin" trend, limited initially to Korean beauty markets, spread rapidly through social media. TikTok alone reportedly drove nearly $32 billion in beauty sales in 2023, making it a crucial resource for identifying trends. By combining social signals with search data, your brand can get a complete picture of emerging untapped market opportunities. Conducting Competitive Analysis to Uncover Untapped Areas Successfully identifying market gaps to capitalize on requires a comprehensive understanding of not only consumer interests and trends but also your competition. Some whitespace opportunities exist because competitors overlook specific needs or consumer segments. Finding out what the competition isn't doing or where they're weak gives brands the opportunity to establish themselves as leaders or innovators before the crowd arrives. When developing a crowded market strategy, you need to identify the spaces where your brand can thrive. Competitive analysis helps you do just that by mapping out what other brands are doing and highlighting what they're not. Successful competitive analysis involves reviewing product lines, messaging and positioning to identify untapped potential that is often hiding in plain sight. For example, you might see skincare brands clustering around the same product types or claims while failing to address another area that is showing clear demand. That's a whitespace opportunity. Likewise, you might analyze product launches and claims across a category to highlight where innovation has slowed or where messaging fails to resonate. Those gaps often represent spaces where demand exists but no other rival is effectively meeting. Know where the competition is weak. When you understand how other brands are navigating the market, you can strategically shape the narrative and position yours as a leader. Finding Gaps Where Competitors Aren't Addressing Consumer Needs Even in highly competitive markets, mismatches often exist between what competitors offer and what consumers truly want. For example, brands may focus on one aspect of a category while completely ignoring other consumer priorities. Studying those disconnects is one of the most effective ways to identify whitespace opportunities. Begin by analyzing consumer interest data, including trending product attributes and popular search queries. Then, use competitive analysis to see if other brands are offering products that align with those interests. Once you start identifying gaps worth exploring, you can validate them by examining which consumer questions are currently unanswered. When thousands of people ask the same question, but no brand provides a clear answer or solution, you have a real opportunity to make an impact in the market. Discover Market Opportunities with Data-Driven Trend Intelligence In a crowded market, winning brands aren't riding the wave of a trend. They're finding the next ones, moving away from reactive strategies and being proactive about finding emerging trends early. Finding untapped opportunities can lead to substantial growth and success for your brand. When you identify whitespace opportunities and act on them, there's less competition, greater opportunity to establish category leadership, and the chance to enter the market with strong positioning. The best way to do that is by using trend forecasting platforms like Spate. With Spate, you can see what big trend is on the horizon before your competitors do. Identify trending ingredients, track competitor positioning and uncover consumer needs gaps you can fill. Spate is your digital truth serum, providing intelligence that helps you develop products and messaging that address real unmet demands. Schedule your Spate demo to learn more and discover the power of trend forecasting firsthand. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) How do you identify whitespace opportunities in a saturated market? You can identify whitespace opportunities by analyzing what consumers want but can't currently find. Combining search volume data with social signals can help highlight emerging trends before they reach the mainstream. Meanwhile, competitive analysis can reveal untapped demands and areas where your rivals fall short, presenting golden opportunities to enter a competitive space while still making a significant impact. What data sources help spot untapped market opportunities? Search data and social signals are the most valuable resources for consumer trend analysis. Analyzing search volume can reveal which trends have momentum and which are merely temporary fads. Meanwhile, social signals can reveal what's capturing consumers' attention. How can brands tell the difference between a trend and a fad? The best way to differentiate short-lived fads from true consumer shifts is to examine year-over-year growth. Interest should rise steadily over time, rather than peak and then fade. Those long-lasting interests have staying power, indicating trends worth capitalizing on. Why is competitive analysis important for finding market gaps? Even in saturated markets, there are still unmet consumer needs. Competitive analysis helps you understand what other brands are doing and what they are not doing. It's an opportunity to see where their products and strategies fall short, highlighting whitespaces ready to take advantage of. How do consumer search patterns reveal unmet needs? Consumer search patterns can indicate that there are still unanswered questions and unmet needs, and the market is failing to provide solutions for them. Surges in questions about specific products, ingredients or attributes signal needs that no brand is currently meeting. ‍

title: The Best Places to Travel in 2026
summary: Explore the top travel destinations for 2026—from Japan to Argentina. Plan your next unforgettable trip with this global list of must-visit cities.
body_text: 2026 is shaping up to be one of the most exciting years for travel. With major world events taking place across the globe, travelers have more reasons than ever to explore. Whether you’re drawn to food, music, sports, or the great outdoors, the destinations in this blog offer something remarkable for every kind of traveler. ‍ ‍ 1. Takayama, Japan Nestled in the mountains of Gifu Prefecture, Takayama offers travelers a glimpse into Japan’s traditional past. Its Edo-period streets, morning markets, and nearby Shirakawa-go village make it a top choice for immersing yourself in the local culture. Visit during the Takayama Spring Festival for ornate floats and timeless celebrations. In 2026, visitors can expect new boutique inns and sustainable travel options enhancing the town’s charm. Local sake breweries and traditional ryokans provide an authentic way to unwind after a day of exploring—and enjoying a seasonal kaiseki dinner at Ryokan Asunaro, where regional ingredients are served on hand-crafted ceramics, is a perfect finish to the day. Takayama captures the beauty of Japan’s countryside while staying well-connected to modern travel routes. ‍ ‍ 2. Tomar, Portugal Home to the UNESCO-listed Convent of Christ, Tomar is perfect for travelers seeking a quieter escape. The city’s medieval streets, riverside cafés, and annual Festa dos Tabuleiros make it one of Europe’s best-kept secrets. In 2026, Portugal’s tourism board is spotlighting Tomar as a hub for history and creativity, with new walking tours and restored monasteries. Its location between Lisbon and Porto makes it an ideal stop for those exploring the country by train, and an evening meal at O Tabuleiro—where locals gather over bacalhau and regional wine—captures the town’s warm, old-world spirit. Visitors can enjoy a balance of heritage and hospitality, which makes Portugal so inviting year-round. ‍ ‍ 3. Milan, Italy When Milan and Cortina d’Ampezzo host the 2026 Winter Olympics , the world will converge on northern Italy. You can expect upgrades across transportation and hospitality, from Milan’s sleek city center to the alpine slopes nearby. The games will showcase Italy’s innovation and artistry on a global stage. Travelers can experience the city’s new Olympic Village, designed with sustainability in mind, or explore Milan’s renowned food and fashion scene—starting with dinner at Ristorante Stendhal Brera, a local favorite known for classic Milanese dishes like saffron risotto and osso buco in the heart of the Brera district. The Olympics will make 2026 a memorable time to visit this modern, yet historic city. ‍ ‍ 4. Philadelphia, USA In 2026, Philadelphia will be at the heart of two major celebrations—the 250th anniversary of the United States, known as the Semiquincentennial, and one of the largest international soccer tournaments in the world. On July 4, 2026, Philadelphia will host a massive celebration, including the Wawa Welcome America festival and other public events spotlighting the nation’s origins. The city will also host six international soccer matches at Lincoln Financial Field (temporarily renamed “Philadelphia Stadium”), including five group-stage games and a Round-of-16 contest on July 4. Between soccer matches and historical celebrations, visitors can enjoy the city’s famed food scene—grabbing a cheesesteak from John’s Roast Pork or exploring the local craft breweries like Philadelphia Brewing Company in Fishtown that reflect Philadelphia’s creative energy. For international travelers visiting the U.S. during this global event, it’s helpful to know that you can enroll in CLEAR+ using your passport and speed through airport security at any of the 62 CLEAR+ airports nationwide. Whether you’re flying into New York, Atlanta, or Miami, CLEAR+ helps make each airport experience easier and more predictable. ‍ ‍ 5. Vienna, Austria Classical grandeur meets pop culture in Vienna, the host city for the Eurovision Song Contest 2026, where you can expect a lively blend of concerts and public viewing parties. Beyond the music, Vienna’s art museums and coffeehouses invite visitors to slow down and savor all the city has to offer. 2026 will see new venues and riverfront spaces designed to host fans and performers alike, and nothing captures Vienna’s café culture better than a slice of chocolate torte at Café Central, once frequented by Freud and Trotsky. Visitors can stroll through Schönbrunn Palace, take in live opera, or enjoy a sunset along the Danube—Vienna perfectly captures Europe’s balance of old-world beauty and modern creativity. ‍ ‍ 6. Banff, Alberta, Canada Already famous for its turquoise lakes and towering peaks, Banff continues to be one of the top mountain destinations for 2026. New ski resort upgrades and sustainable travel initiatives will make it even more appealing to adventure seekers. Travelers can look forward to expanded lift access, eco-lodges, and guided wildlife experiences. The area’s natural beauty—from Moraine Lake to the Icefields Parkway—remains unmatched, and few experiences rival taking in panoramic alpine views from the Banff Gondola Summit, where a boardwalk connects mountaintop viewpoints overlooking six mountain ranges. In 2026, Banff is expected to welcome a record number of visitors drawn to its pristine air and upgraded amenities. ‍ ‍ 7. Mendoza, Argentina Mendoza is experiencing a spike in tourism thanks to its award-winning wineries and new eco-retreats in the Andes. Enjoy vineyard tours, thermal spas, and stargazing in one of South America’s most scenic regions. The 2026 season will bring new wellness resorts and boutique lodges blending luxury with sustainability. Local vineyards are introducing biodynamic practices, offering travelers an immersive, environmentally responsible experience. Travelers can enjoy a tasting at Bodega Catena Zapata at a striking pyramid-shaped winery that produces some of Argentina’s best Malbec. Whether sipping wine at sunset or exploring the foothills of the Andes, Mendoza offers a perfect mix of relaxation and adventure. ‍ ‍ 8. León, Spain On August 12, 2026, a total solar eclipse will pass over parts of Spain, with León and nearby Castellón de la Plana offering some of the best viewing conditions in the world. It’s a once-in-a-lifetime moment worth traveling for. León’s medieval architecture, tapas culture, and vibrant plazas will provide the perfect setting before and after the eclipse, especially in Barrio Húmedo, where locals wander from bar to bar sampling cured meats and Rioja wine. title: The Future of Universal Gaming Controllers: One Controller for PC, Console, Mobile
summary: Universal gaming controllers are reshaping cross-platform play. Market hits $3B in 2025 with 53% compatibility adoption across devices.
body_text: Gaming used to mean choosing your platform and sticking with it. Your Xbox controller stayed with Xbox, your PlayStation pad never left the console, and mobile gaming meant awkward touchscreen controls. That era is over. Cross-platform compatibility has hit 53% among gaming controllers , and the universal gaming controller market is experiencing explosive growth as gamers demand seamless experiences across every device they own. The shift makes sense when you consider how we actually play games now. You might start a session on your gaming PC at home, continue on your phone during your commute, then pick it back up on your console in the living room. Why should you need three different controllers for the same game? Why Universal Controllers Are Taking Over Gaming The numbers tell a compelling story. The gamepads market grew from $2.74 billion in 2024 to $3.02 billion in 2025, with projections showing it will reach $4.80 billion by 2030. More importantly, over 57% of consumers now seek controllers that function with both Android and iOS, and that expectation extends to console and PC compatibility as well. Cloud gaming deserves much of the credit for this transformation. Services like Xbox Game Pass Ultimate, GeForce NOW, and PlayStation Plus have made it possible to play AAA titles on devices that would never have the horsepower to run them locally. When you can stream major titles to your phone, having a quality controller that works everywhere becomes essential. Wireless technology has kept pace with these demands. Wireless controllers now account for more than 55% of the market, with Bluetooth adoption reaching 72%. Modern protocols like Bluetooth 5.0 and proprietary low-latency connections make switching between your PC, console, and mobile device feel instantaneous. The Stealth Ultra Controller exemplifies this evolution, offering seamless connectivity across multiple platforms with minimal input lag. What Makes a Great Universal Gaming Controller in 2025 Not all universal controllers are created equal. The best ones share several key features that separate them from budget alternatives or platform-specific options. Multi-Platform Compatibility Without Compromise A true universal controller needs to work natively with Windows PC, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, Android, and iOS. Crucially, it should offer full functionality on each platform, not just basic button mapping. You want rumble, gyro controls, and all the features you'd get from a first-party controller. The Victrix Pro BFG Reloaded Wireless Controller takes this seriously with modular components that let you customize your setup for different gaming scenarios. Whether you're grinding ranked matches on PC or playing single-player adventures on console, the controller adapts to your needs with 11 interchangeable components. Hall Effect Technology to Eliminate Stick Drift Stick drift has plagued traditional controllers for years, causing frustration for gamers who invest hundreds of dollars in premium hardware only to see it fail within months. Hall Effect joysticks and triggers solve this problem by using magnetic sensors instead of physical contact points. The technology virtually eliminates drift and dead zones, delivering consistent precision even after thousands of hours of gameplay. The difference is especially noticeable for competitive players and anyone who takes their gaming seriously. In fast-paced shooters or precision platformers, unreliable inputs can mean the difference between victory and defeat. Ergonomics for Extended Gaming Sessions Comfort becomes non-negotiable when you're holding a controller for hours. The best universal controllers balance weight distribution, grip texture, and button placement to reduce hand fatigue. Features like textured grips, contoured designs, and strategically placed buttons make marathon gaming sessions actually enjoyable. Consider how you'll use the controller, too. Mobile gaming typically means holding the device differently than console play. Controllers with adjustable phone clips or detachable components offer flexibility for different scenarios. Low-Latency Connection Options Wireless freedom is great, but not if it comes with noticeable input lag. Premium universal controllers offer multiple connection methods like 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth 5.0, and wired USB-C. The ability to switch connection types means you can prioritize battery life for casual play or plug in for competitive zero-latency gaming. The Stealth Pivot Controller stands out here with its innovative approach to multi-platform gaming. The modular design keeps your devices secure while maintaining ergonomic comfort, and multiple connectivity options ensure you're never stuck with subpar input response. Turtle Beach's Universal Controller Solutions Mobile Gaming Excellence For iOS users, the Atom Controller provides Xbox-licensed wireless connectivity with magnetic portability. Its 2.4GHz wireless connection eliminates pairing delays when switching between mobile and other platforms, while the split design fits in your pocket. Professional Gaming Performance The Victrix Gambit Prime Wired Controller delivers tournament-grade performance with a wired connection and professional microswitches designed for competitive play across PC and console platforms. Budget-Friendly Universal Options The Rematch Advanced Wired Controller and Rematch Core Wired Controller provide essential multi-platform features like textured grips and responsive buttons at accessible price points. Building Your Complete Gaming Ecosystem Consider how your controller choice fits into your broader gaming environment. Your ultimate couch gaming setup should prioritize controllers that work seamlessly across all platforms. For specialized gaming, Victrix Pro KO elevates your fighting game performance with precision inputs that work consistently across platforms. Understanding leverless vs traditional fight sticks competitive play helps competitive players choose universal setups. The buying guide for trending gaming gifts can help identify controller combinations that work together across multiple gaming platforms. Choosing the Right Universal Controller for Your Setup Selecting the right universal gaming controller comes down to understanding your specific needs and gaming habits. If you split time between PC and Xbox, prioritize controllers with native Xbox support and Windows compatibility. For PlayStation and PC gamers, look for controllers that support advanced features on compatible titles. Mobile gamers should consider portable controllers for better ergonomics. Budget matters, but think long-term. A $150 controller with Hall Effect technology and premium build quality will outlast multiple budget controllers that develop drift within months. The future belongs to controllers that adapt to how you actually game. With universal controllers, your muscle memory travels with you across every platform. FAQ What is a universal gaming controller? A universal gaming controller works across multiple gaming platforms, including PC, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, and mobile devices. These controllers typically support multiple connection methods like Bluetooth, 2.4GHz wireless, and USB-C, allowing gamers to use one controller for all their devices. Are universal controllers as good as platform-specific controllers? Premium universal controllers now match or exceed platform-specific options in most areas. While some platform-exclusive features may have limited support, universal controllers often include advantages like Hall Effect technology, longer battery life, and extensive customization options. What should I look for when buying a cross-platform controller? Focus on verified multi-platform compatibility, Hall Effect joysticks to prevent drift, comfortable ergonomics, low-latency wireless options, and customization features like programmable buttons. Battery life is also important, with modern controllers offering 15 to 40+ hours depending on the connection method.

Introducing Agent Connectors from Airbyte
summary: Introducing Agent Connectors from Airbyte enabling AI agents to securely access, sync, and act on real-time data across your tools and systems.
body_text: Today, we're launching Agent Connectors: open-source Python SDKs purpose-built to give AI agents consistent, real-time access to operational data for context-rich decision making. This is the start of building the data infrastructure layer that connects AI agents to enterprise systems. What We're Launching Open-source Agent Connectors for 10 critical operational systems: Gong, Zendesk Support, GitHub, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, Asana, Stripe, Greenhouse, and Linear. These are standalone Python packages you can use directly in your app or plug into any agent framework , giving your agentic applications strongly typed, well-documented access to third-party APIs. Each connector enables critical agent operations including fetch, search, and discovery in real-time. Try them now: Repo: Airbyte Agent Connectors Docs: Available here The Problem AI agents are limited by the tools they can call. Most context lives inside SaaS APIs that hold CRM records, support tickets, billing events, recruiting pipelines, code repositories, and operational data. Yet giving agents reliable access to these APIs remains difficult. Every integration becomes a custom wrapper, every schema behaves differently, and every edge case becomes another source of operational risk. None of these patterns support agents that need real-time decisions and just-in-time context retrieval. The infrastructure layer between agents and operational systems doesn't exist. Everyone's building custom integrations, duplicating work, and creating reliability nightmares. How Agent Connectors Work Agent Connectors are standalone Python packages that wrap operational APIs with strongly-typed interfaces. Each connector handles authentication , validates schemas, and exposes operations through consistent method signatures that both developers and LLMs can interpret reliably. PYTHON from airbyte_agent_gong import GongConnector from airbyte_agent_gong.models import GongAuthConfig # Create connector connector = GongConnector( auth_config=GongAuthConfig( access_key= "..." , access_key_secret= "..." ) ) users = await connector.users. list (limit= 10 ) Attaching this to an agent is straightforward: PYTHON @agent.tool_plain async def list_users ( limit: int = 10 ): return await connector.users. list (limit=limit) Under the hood, they derive typed request and response models from the underlying API specifications, enforce schema validation at runtime, and provide transparent error handling. This gives agents the low-latency primitives they need for real-time fetch, search, and action operations without the brittleness of ad hoc API wrappers or the staleness of batch ETL. Each connector is delivered as an independent Python package with a predictable structure: CODE connectors/ ├── gong/ │ ├── airbyte_agent_gong/ │ ├── pyproject.toml │ ├── CHANGELOG.md │ └── README.md │ └── REFERENCE.md ├── github/ │ └── ... └── ... The REFERENCE.md file in each connector documents all available operations from listing sources to fetching specific records and executing actions. This gives both developers and Agents a complete map of what each connector can do. For example, the Gong connector reference details operations like ‘users.list(), users.get(), calls.list(), and more, with full type information for each. Every connector can be used directly in a Python application, attached to frameworks like PydanticAI or LangChain, integrated into any custom agent loop, or exposed through MCP-based interfaces for tool-calling LLMs. Why we’re building this We've built a company on moving data reliably. We have 20,000+ GitHub stars, thousands of customers, and millions of pipelines synced daily. We've built and maintained hundreds of open-source connectors with a community of 27,000+ developers. But as AI agents have emerged, I've noticed a challenge that dramatically limits their success: most enterprise APIs weren't designed for LLMs or agent execution models. As agents must interact with real operational systems, developers write custom wrappers, manage authentication constraints, normalize schemas, and handle inconsistent error behavior across every system their agent touches. This works at small scale but breaks when agents need to call multiple systems reliably. Agent Connectors bring our connector expertise to agent workloads, providing a consistent way to fetch and search operational data without writing custom integration code for each system. Why this matters I think agentic AI represents the biggest shift in software since the move to cloud. But the infrastructure layer needed to make it work in production doesn't exist yet. We're not building another agent orchestrator or LLM framework. We're building the connection between facts and intelligence: the data layer that every framework plugs into. The companies that win with AI won't be the ones with the best models. They'll be the ones who figured out how to give those models reliable access to live business context. What's Next This launch is just the beginning. We're expanding Agent Connectors in two key directions: Write Operations: Beyond read access, we're adding write and trigger capabilities so agents can create records, update fields, and initiate workflows across systems. Connector Library Expansion: We're scaling from the initial 10 connectors to hundreds over the coming months, bringing the full breadth of our connector ecosystem to agent workloads. We plan to continually expand the connector library using our expertise in data movement and community contributions to the open-source GitHub repo. Learn more here. Get Involved This is open source for a reason. We are all in uncharted territory, however we all know that the future of AI is Open-Source. We want to work with all of you to define what agentic data infrastructure looks like. Try the connectors: github.com/airbytehq/airbyte-agent-connectors Give us a star ⭐ if you find it useful Contribute: Join #agent-connectors-discussions on the Airbyte Slack to share your feedback Talk to us: DM me on LinkedIn or X if you're building agents and want to discuss your data infrastructure needs The future of AI depends on solving the data infrastructure layer. Let's build it together!
